text: Ɓen ferunooɓe, ɓe acci galleeji e ɓeynguureeji maɓɓe, e jawle maɓɓe, ɓe iwi e leydi keeferaaku faade e leydi lislaamu, fii ɗaɓɓugol welayee Alla, ɓaawo nde heeferɓe ɓen lepti ɓe, ɓe ɓiɗtinani ɓe; ma Men weernu ɓen ka aduna e galle teddungal. Pellet, ko mbarjaari laakara ndin ɓuri, tawde Aljanna ko e mayri jeyaa. Si tawno ɓee luutondiray ɓe fii ferugol anndayno mbarjaari ferugol ngol, ɓe luutondirtaano fii ɗum.
